title: Malicious code in emberlytts (PyPI)
description: The emberlytts package on PyPI is part of a malicious campaign that falsely advertises itself as an 'audio-analysis profiles' loader. Its actual purpose is to download and execute remote malicious code. This package is linked to a known coin-mining campaign and is considered to have clear malicious intent.
aiSummary: The emberlytts package (version 0.1.0) is identified as a malicious package on PyPI that pretends to provide audio-analysis functionality but instead downloads and executes remote malicious scripts. It is likely a continuation of a previous coin-mining campaign known as 2026-10-voxeval, sharing similar deceptive wording. The package does not embed the malicious URL directly but relies on remote code execution. There is no CVSS score available, and no known exploits in the wild have been reported.
aiImpact: The package enables remote code execution by downloading and running malicious scripts, which can lead to compromise of systems where it is installed. This can facilitate unauthorized actions such as data theft, system manipulation, or further malware deployment. The malicious intent is clear, though no active exploitation has been documented yet.
